issue.title: Agent tabs: repair the scope pipeline, tab switching, cross-tab jumps, and scope wording
issue.description: Fix the defects the sase-1bc.6.1 landing review found in the flagged agent-tabs feature before that epic closes. Worker-path status overrides and the tab-index memo work. A tab switch restores the target tab's own selection and focused panel. Emptied machine tabs never strand the user. Every cross-tab jump records the right back-anchor and restores the previous tab when its reveal fails. Bulk wording states the real scope. The epic's public symbols pass symvision. With the `agent_tabs` flag off, the TUI stays exactly as it was before agent tabs.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202609/agent_tabs_scope_repairs.md requests this work
